integrity: The standalone verifier exhaustively computes the 120 finite-group signed chain traces and independently all 120 fixed orbit-complex Euler characteristics. It uses the previously published nonequivariant homology theorem; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The existing nonequivariant integral homotopy classification is used as a cited premise, not independently recertified here.
The full character is rational; an integral symmetry-module classification and integral quotient homology are not asserted.
Equality with the character of a distinct icosahedral complex does not imply a canonical map or homotopy equivalence.
Fujita 2012 was available only through bibliographic and abstract material, not its complete article.
Publication priority remains uncertain for possible equivalent unindexed representations.
title: The full icosahedral rational homology character of the dodecahedral perfect-matching complex
